title: check-adr-0087-registration: a type literal in an interface or class header (type parameter constraint or heritage) makes the type-position reader read an annotated member as erased
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxRDKprCtjpEdtiPFW

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding of the #37445 dev (os-dev report, #37445 comment 7233468940), confirmed real by L1-a on PR #38137 (7233892416). Source: seat repo:objectstack#1 area `o1-F`.
Grading: area:fleet · Bug · p2 · reach: ADR-0087 predicate 4 readings of a member inside an interface or class whose header carries a type literal · evidence: measured at `adfdb84b`.
Dedupe: `braceOpensTypeBody`, `sitsInTypePosition heritage` → 0 open hits.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：发版检查里有个读类型的工具，遇到接口或类的声明头里带 `{ ... }`（例如 `T extends { id: string }`）时，会把里面有类型标注的成员当成「没有标注」。这个方向偏宽：本该拦下的改动可能被放行。
- 修法：让它正确识别声明头里的类型字面量，并补上能证明修好的测试。
- 要你做的：无。

## Measured (at `adfdb84b`)

- `readTypeSurfaceRef` answers "carries NO return annotation" (erased) for `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/SortableFavoriteRows.tsx#SortableFavoriteRowsProps.renderRow`, an annotated function-typed property.
- Cause: `braceOpensTypeBody` reads its header back only to the previous brace, so an interface or class header that carries a type literal (`T extends { id: string }`, or `extends Base<{ a: 1 }>`) is not classified as a type body, and `sitsInTypePosition` falls back to the value reading. The bare spelling gives the same reading.
- Direction: permissive for predicate 4 (a concrete base reads as erased).

## Acceptance

- A member of an interface or class whose header carries a type literal reads its annotation; the real instance above resolves to its annotation.
- Pins: header type literal in a constraint and in heritage, with a lit control; an ablation reds them.
- Carry L1's optional nits from PR #38137 in the same PR: N1 (`containerBodiesFor` docstring names the interface and type-literal kinds), N2 (predicate 4 refusal prose line break), N3 (a pin for the companion-object case, `interface X` plus an object literal `X = {`, which reads AMBIGUOUS).

Surface: `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (the #38093 reader). Serial with #37447 if that card's PR also edits this file.
Blocked-by: none
